$comment: The source of sf-header-page's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/page-header (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

heading.summary: The page heading, drawn as the fourth heading step

count.summary: How many records the page holds, as the host writes it (448, ~1 200); empty draws no count

level.summary: install marks a page shared by every site

star.summary: Absent draws no star; false (or off) and true (or on) draw it in that state

toggle.summary: The person pressed the star: the request to make the page a favourite (on) or not; a host that answers itself cancels it and writes star

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: The header is page content: a <header> holding the page's one h1. It is no landmark of its own (role none for the element); the star is the native button of the sf-icon-button it draws, with a name that says what pressing it does, and so its state: no aria-pressed (rule C12).

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-header-page for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.summary: The person pressed the star. Cancelable: a host that waits for its own answer cancels it and sets star itself.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-header-page; sf-page-header is a subclass defined beside it until the date
the event name carries the tag

x-summary: The head of an admin page: path, heading, count, favourite star, install mark and main action. Replaces the admin top bar together with sf-admin-menu.
x-renamed: events.sf-page-header-star → toggle: the star's request is the vocabulary's toggle (§5), as stand 24 decided; sf-page-header-toggle {on}, cancelable, the old sf-page-header-star its dated same-detail alias
settings.star: enum '' | off | on → an optional boolean (§4.2): absent draws no star; off and on are read as false and true, so the markup written today keeps its meaning
x-decisions: toggle (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5, stand 24): pressing the star sends sf-page-header-toggle {on}, cancelable; not cancelled, the header writes star itself; a host that waits for its own answer cancels it and writes star when it knows. The old sf-page-header-star follows as a dated same-detail alias until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

star is an optional boolean (§4.2): absent is unset and draws no star; the attribute's words off and on read as false and true (the base's reading), so star="off"/"on" written today keep their meaning. star="" (present and empty) is now true, the standard's attribute form; the old empty meant «no star», which absent says.

count stays a string (number-type): it is a figure the host writes for people -- 448, ~1 200 for an estimate (vocabulary §2.1 total-is) -- and the header only shows it; a number would lose the host's formatting. Empty draws no count.
a11y-role: none for the element. It draws a <header> holding the page's one h1 inside the page's main content, which is no banner landmark; the role belongs to the page's layout, not to this part.
a11y-name: the header's name is its heading (the h1's text); the star's name is the language file's runtime.star or runtime.unstar, what pressing it does.
key-effects: Tab reach; Enter and Space press the star's native button (toggle:star).
version 1.1.0: the event is renamed behind a dated alias and star's type changed with its old words kept (§4.10).
version 1.1.1: the line holds the star's height (the size 1/2 control height) whether the star is drawn or not, so the star arriving with the host's data moves nothing below (stand 24 F3, gate 24).
words (§11): all-sites, star and unstar are the language files' runtime words, read with sfWord; PAGE_HEADER_TEXT is gone.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (a catalogue with a count and a star) plus an install page, a favourite, a path and an action, and a header without a star.

css-variables: five public variables of a sheet of its own (scss/): the gap between the path and the line, the line's gap, the actions' gap, the heading's colour and the favourite star's colour. The gaps were utilities in the template; they are the sheet's now, so a page can change them. Listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json.
source-drift: the shipped manifest differs from 5100227 only in its provenance hashes and the rule's relation names (cl-badge, cl-button-icon, cl-icon); the interface is the same, nothing to carry.

version 1.1.2: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.3: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.5: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: the tag is sf-header-page (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.header-page and the bundle cl-header-page follow it. sf-page-header stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-header-page, sf-page-header) (change journal tag-sf-page-header-to-sf-header-page, path-smart-page-header-to-header-page).

version 1.2.1: the star is a toggle through sf-button-icon's pressed setting (sf-button-icon 1.4.0, duplication audit A-10) instead of an aria-pressed written on the host: the native button says aria-pressed as before and, while on, wears the selected look.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-07): the star carries no aria-pressed (docs review R028, rule C12). Its name already changes with the state («В избранное», «Убрать из избранного»), and a name that says the state with aria-pressed beside it reads «Убрать из избранного, нажата». The star no longer sets pressed on its sf-button-icon, so it does not wear the toggle's pressed fill either: the filled glyph in --sf-page-header-star-color and the name show the state, as before.

version 1.2.3 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

$comment: The header draws a badge for its count and its install mark, and an icon
button for its star; a tag it renders is a tag it fetches.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-header-page at the top of every admin page: it is the only place a page states its path, heading, count, favourite and main action once the admin top bar is gone.
do_not: Do not keep favourites in the component; answer sf-page-header-star from the host
Do not put totals in the menu; they belong here
Do not style the heading yourself; it is the fourth heading step
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-header-page heading="Каталог решений" count="448" star="off"><sf-breadcrumbs slot="path"><sf-breadcrumbs-item href="/">simai.ru</sf-breadcrumbs-item><sf-breadcrumbs-item href="/data">Данные</sf-breadcrumbs-item></sf-breadcrumbs><sf-button slot="actions" icon-start="add">Создать</sf-button></sf-header-page>

keyboard: Tab reaches the star and the actions
Enter or Space toggles the star
accessibility.focus: The star is a native button in sf-icon-button with a label that says what pressing it does, and so its state; it carries no aria-pressed (rule C12).

sf-page-header-star.summary: The person pressed the star. Cancelable: a host that waits for its own answer cancels it and sets star itself.
